name: speech-elevenlabs
description: ElevenLabs speech provider: an agent's replies spoken by Eleven v4 Turbo (or v4, or Flash v2.5) with word-level caption timing, and live voice conversations through an ElevenLabs agent that hands repository work to your coding agent. Choose it from a voice profile by naming the provider "elevenlabs".

setup.title: Create an ElevenLabs API key
setup.detail: In ElevenLabs open Developers, then API Keys, and create a key. Turn on Text to Speech (required) and Voices: Read (optional; it lists your own voices in the picker). To talk live, also turn on the Agents (ConvAI) permissions, read and write: Live creates one shared agent called dimension-live on your account the first time you start a call. The key stays on this machine and is sent only to api.elevenlabs.io. Setting ELEVENLABS_API_KEY in the environment works too.

setup.title: Choose it in a voice profile
setup.detail: Connecting changes nobody's voice. A voice profile picks ElevenLabs by naming provider "elevenlabs", a model (eleven_v4_turbo is the default) and a voice id; a profile can list a keyless on-device voice after it as the fallback. For live calls a profile lists ElevenLabs under converse; the live-eleven profile shipped with this pack does.

form.label: ElevenLabs API key
form.help: Needs the Text to Speech permission, and the Agents (ConvAI) read and write permissions for live calls. Stored only on this machine.
